map.分度值误差计算器按读数规则估算 ±半分度值引入的读数误差，适合游标、千分尺等器具: The division value error calculator estimates the reading error introduced by ± half a division value per reading rules, for error assessment and uncertainty analysis of vernier calipers, micrometers and similar instruments.
map.读数误差约 ± 分度值/2。: Reading error is about ± division value/2.
map.：估读误差约 ±(0.5~1)*分度值。例：卡尺 0.02 mm 分度，读数误差: : estimation error about ±(0.5 to 1) × division value. Example: a caliper with 0.02 mm division gives reading error about ±0.01 to 0.02 mm.
map.：读数极限误差=±0.005/2=±0.0025 mm，下限 −0.0025。这: : reading limit error = ±0.005/2 = ±0.0025 mm, lower bound −0.0025. This is the maximum error estimated by reading rules; actual reading error is usually smaller.

map.由偏倚与标准差求偏移修正能力指数: Offset correction capability index from bias and standard deviation
map.由零件变差与测量误差求可区分类别数: Number of distinct categories from part variation and measurement error
map.由测量标准差与公差带求精度公差比: Precision-to-tolerance ratio from measurement standard deviation and tolerance band
map.数显分辨率即最小显示位，记录到一位估读。: The digital display resolution is the smallest displayed digit, recorded to one estimated digit.
